notes:
A mod you delete now stays deleted.

Two things could bring a deleted mod back. If a machine couldn't remove it straight away (usually because Valheim had it open), the next sync treated the leftover as a fresh install and put it back on every machine. And a Thunderstore mod deleted from the Mods page stayed on the update list, so its next release reinstalled it.

Now a deletion is permanent: leftovers are removed again (and retried until they go), deleted mods are dropped from the update list, and deletions never expire. The only way a deleted mod comes back is you installing it again yourself.

Also: updating a disabled Thunderstore mod no longer turns it back on.

Update MegaLoad on every machine you use - an older version elsewhere can still bring a mod back.
